style: Avant-garde garage rock and doo-wop vocal pop. Modal drone harmony with parallel triads, non-diatonic cluster rubs, and bitonal layers. Angular punk cells opening into chromatic cabaret patter and yodel flips. Stuttering stop-start punk pulse with waltz-duple invasions and 7/8 pockets. Fuzz guitar, cheap transistor organ, upright bass, handclaps, and dry mono drums. Close barbershop harmony, deadpan speech-song, and fast patter. Bureaucratic solemnity mixed with aggressive garage recklessness. 1960s dry mono room capture with analog tape saturation. Operators: Hold the bass anchor fixed while upper triads migrate; compress rhythm while stretching vowel duration; make harmonic closure behave like an arithmetic error; preserve the handclap invariant while destabilizing the meter.
lyrics:
[Intro: Dry mono room hiss, sparse upright bass drone, single crisp handclap on the offbeat]
[Verse 1]
The synthesizer is broken.
We have classified its absence as a statistical ledger of missing integers.
[Spoken deadpan, close-mic]
If zero is an absence of voltage,
and absence is a positive proof of nothing,
then the hum is a witness statement signed by a ghost.
[Harmony blooms, tight barbershop parallel triads, fuzz guitar enters with a dry stuttering pulse]
Proof! Proof of nothing!
A logical deduction executed at forty cycles per second!
[Chorus: Aggressive garage rock stomp, waltz-duple invasion in 7/8 time]
The voltage drops, the proof survives!
We measure the silence where the oscillator thrives!
It does not oscillate, it demonstrates!
It calculates the perimeter of empty gates!
[Interlude: Stop-start organ stabs, handclaps, abrupt metric compression]
[Verse 2]
The Memory Mold returns, scarred and recursive.
What was once a square wave is now a remembered rectangle.
[Hocketed vocal fragments, rapid patter]
Remember the voltage?
We never had voltage.
Remember the oscillator?
We never had oscillators.
We have only the proof that the circuit was never here.
[Bridge: Chromatic cabaret patter, upright bass slides, microtonal cluster rubs]
By Axiom Vandal, we negate the power supply!
Without electricity, the mathematics multiply!
A negative load-bearing argument holds up the roof!
If there is no synthesizer, the proof is foolproof!
[Guitar solo: Fuzz pedal saturated, highly angular, jagged intervals, dry mono room bleed]
[Verse 3]
The Flow Ghoul dissolves the copper traces into rates of decay.
Maintenance work replaces the melody.
[Whispered ensemble rhythm under full-voice lead]
Wipe the terminals.
Scrape the oxide.
Measure the heat loss of an unbuilt machine.
[Chorus: Full garage band propulsion, close vocal harmony, aggressive handclaps]
The voltage drops, the proof survives!
We measure the silence where the oscillator thrives!
It does not oscillate, it demonstrates!
It calculates the perimeter of empty gates!
[Outro: Sudden drop to solo upright bass and deadpan speech]
Theorem proven.
There is no machine.
There is only the proof of its absence.
[Single dry handclap, tape stop, absolute silence]

caption: An avant-garde garage rock and doo-wop art-pop collision where a broken synthesizer is classified as a literal proof of absence. Governed by taxonomic error and recursive memory mutation, featuring tight barbershop harmonies, jagged fuzz guitar, 7/8 asymmetric meters, and dry 1960s mono tape saturation.
